No legend text, key or header collides with reference lines or data marks. Both guides occupy compact regions while the scatter remains visually primary.

These visually estimated complete-guide bounds occupy about 5% of the plot in total, with no reserved outside band. They are approximate inspection guides, not the implementation QA bounding boxes.

Filled circles vary in size; blue, red and grey class keys match their clouds. No contrasting outline appears on quantitative marks or size keys. The size guide visibly increases from 0.25 through 0.5 to 1; exact area correspondence was checked separately by the independent numerical auditor.

Two grey vertical dashed references bracket x = 0 and remain clear above the low-y cloud. The horizontal dashed reference near y = 2 remains visible at both sides; marks cover it in the dense central base as expected.

The occupied lower cloud conveys many observations, and the sparse tall left side needs its white space. The unoccupied upper-right region accommodates guides without compressing the data box.
